default.heading: Build more with AI. Automate the busywork.
default.body: Get my emails on using AI and automation in your business, plus a look at what I’m building, trying and learning in mine. Practical ideas and lessons you can take into your own work.

AI decisions.heading: Where could AI take work off your plate?
AI decisions.body: Get my emails on choosing useful AI applications, trying them in a real workflow and checking the results. Alongside the practical ideas, I share what I’m trying in the businesses I’m building.

Software decisions.heading: Know what to build, buy or automate.
Software decisions.body: Get my emails on using AI, choosing tools and deciding what is worth building. I share the decisions and trade-offs behind my own businesses, so you have more to go on when making yours.

Customer follow-up.heading: What else could you automate in your business?
Customer follow-up.body: Get my emails on using AI and automation to reduce routine work, from chasing updates to moving information between tools. Plus the experiments, decisions and lessons from building my own businesses.

Building businesses.heading: See how I’m building my next businesses.
Building businesses.body: Get my emails on where I use AI, what I choose to automate and what I still do myself. I share the tools, trade-offs and mistakes along the way, with lessons you can take into your own business.
